verdict.rationale: Smooth's docs say the agent can reach localhost and local development servers through a secure tunnel ('self' P2P tunnel), which is pitched for testing local apps. They also describe a QA-style testing use case. This lets users point the agent at a dev or staging app instead of production, but Smooth itself offers no documented sandbox or test mode. Missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox/test environment or test API keys, any isolation guarantees for test runs versus production data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
